description: Use this when a user asks what people actually paid for the right to own or buy a car (an entitlement or quota certificate, a sale or an auction result) in Singapore car ownership rights (COE) (country SG). Returns the median winning price, a typical range (10th–90th percentile), the number of bidding rounds or sales, the period covered, a confidence label, and the official source and licence. Do not use for asking prices, dealer listings, or other countries.

country.description: SG = Singapore COE (Certificate of Entitlement) bidding results

months.description: How many recent months to include. Default 12.

product.description: Which price. 'coe' = Certificate of Entitlement bidding results (the country notes say where it exists). Default 'coe'. SG: 'coe'.

vehicle_class.description: SG only: COE category. A = cars up to 1600cc (default), B = cars above 1600cc, C = goods vehicles/buses, D = motorcycles, E = open.

name: pricepaid_car_prices

outputSchema.description: Price range from real records: price, sample_size, period, confidence, source and licence.

summary.description: One sentence an AI can quote.

title: Car-related prices actually paid
